introH2: 🏙️ Why does choosing the right base in Ubon Ratchathani matter?
introHtml: Ubon Ratchathani, the hub of southern Isan, has a compact centre — most key spots sit within the municipal area, a few minutes apart. Thung Si Mueang is the park in the centre of town, home to Wat Si Ubon Rattanaram and Wat Thung Si Mueang, and the venue for the Candle Festival. Sunee City Mall is the city's big shopping centre, with a mall, cinema and night market. The airport quarter (UBP) is very close to town, handy if you fly in and want to stay nearby. And the Mun riverside is the old-town quarter, with a morning market and old wooden houses. Many people come to Ubon to head onward to Khong Chiam, Pha Taem, Sam Phan Bok, or to break the journey before crossing into Laos at Chong Mek, then book without checking whether they're near what they came for. This guide rounds up 12 Ubon Ratchathani hotels we've picked across every tier — from a 5-star mall hotel to high-scoring boutiques, down to a value riverside hostel — each with an honest take from real reviews, prices compared on 3 sites, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Ubon Ratchathani has no metro, but the city is compact — a Grab or a songthaew is cheap and easy. From Ubon Ratchathani Airport (UBP) it's about 10 minutes into town, and there's a railway station at Warin Chamrap across the Mun River for those arriving by train. The main areas in this guide: Thung Si Mueang · city centre — park, temples, market, walkable to a lot · Sunee City Mall — mall, cinema, night market, a mall-connected hotel · airport quarter — near the airport, handy for fly-in and connecting travellers · the Mun riverside — the old town, morning market, a wooden-house hostel · Chaeng Sanit · Chayangkun Roads — the main in-town routes, easy to get around.

entries.name: Sunee Grand Hotel and Convention Center
entries.revCount: 471 reviews · most-reviewed, best location in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chayangkun Rd · attached to Sunee City Mall
entries.addr: 512/8 Chayangkun Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani
entries.storyHtml: Sunee Grand is a 5-star, 222-room hotel that connects straight into Sunee City Mall, and the most-reviewed in this list with 471 reviews, scoring 9.2. The draw is a location where you walk from the lobby into the mall, cinema, supermarket and night market, plus a water park and outdoor pool that families love, a gym, a Thai-massage spa and a large convention centre. It's a fit for families, business travellers and anyone who wants everything close at hand. Real reviews praise the mall-side location (location scores around 9.6), the value and the free parking, even if cleanliness varies between rooms.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a renovated (2022) room when you book — they're noticeably fresher — and with kids, a room near the pool makes the water park easy. During the Candle Festival (July) rooms fill fast, so book several weeks ahead.
pros: Most-reviewed in the list, 471 reviews, 9.2 score
Connects to Sunee City Mall — walk to the mall, cinema, night market
Has a water park and pool — great for families
Free parking, airport shuttle, gym, spa and convention centre
cons: The hotel opened in 2009; cleanliness and room condition vary between rooms
Breakfast leans Asian; the menu can repeat over a longer stay

entries.name: V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani
entries.addr: 63 Chaeng Sanit Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani
entries.storyHtml: V Hotel is a 4-star city hotel that scores a high 9.2 from a starting price of just ฿800 across 117 reviews. It sits on Chaeng Sanit Road in the city centre, opened in 2015 so it still feels modern. The draw is clean, modern rooms, from standard up to Premier and rooms with a balcony, plus free parking. It's a tidy choice for those who want a quality hotel in the centre without paying a premium. Real reviews praise the cleanliness, the value, the location and the service — a fit for couples, families and travellers driving themselves.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a few hundred baht more, the Double with Balcony feels airier, and the Chaeng Sanit Road location is a quick Grab to Thung Si Mueang or the mall, with free parking for those driving.
pros: High-scoring 4-star at 9.2 from just ฿800
Opened 2015, clean and modern rooms
Chaeng Sanit Road location, central, easy to get around
Has free parking, some rooms with a balcony
cons: A city hotel — no pool or resort-style facilities
Few restaurants within walking distance; you'll need a car to go out for food

entries.name: Rapeepan Ville Hotel
entries.revCount: 41 reviews · highest score in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Sukha Uppatham · near Ubon airport
entries.addr: 9 Sukha Uppatham Soi 11, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani
entries.storyHtml: Rapeepan Ville is a small boutique that earns the highest score in this list at 9.4 across 41 reviews. It sits on Soi Sukha Uppatham, near Ubon airport but still in town. The draw is a small, quiet hotel with rooms in a contemporary Thai style, an on-site restaurant and free parking. It's a fit for those who fly into Ubon and want to stay near the airport, or who want somewhere quieter than the big-road hotels. Real reviews praise the cleanliness, the friendly service, the quiet and the food, even if it has fewer reviews than the other in-town hotels.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you arrive early or are connecting onward, the near-airport location saves travel time, and the larger Premier room — some with a balcony — is worth it for a multi-night stay.
pros: Highest score in the list, 9.4 across 41 reviews
A small, quiet boutique with contemporary Thai rooms
Near Ubon airport — a fit for fly-in and connecting travellers
Has an on-site restaurant and free parking

entries.name: B2 Ubon Boutique & Budget Hotel
entries.revCount: 223 reviews · budget chain, fresh rooms, heavily reviewed
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Rai Noi area · near Ubon airport
entries.addr: 499 Moo 12, Rai Noi, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani
entries.storyHtml: B2 Ubon is a budget boutique-chain hotel that scores a high 9.0 and is heavily reviewed with 223 reviews, from a starting price of just ฿550. It sits in the Rai Noi area, near Ubon airport. The draw is a B2-chain hotel with modern, fairly fresh rooms, an LED TV, a fridge and free parking, ranging from a double up to a Family Suite that sleeps up to five. It's excellent value for those focused on a low price who still want a clean, newer room. Real reviews praise the value, the cleanliness, the fresh rooms and the near-airport location.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a group, the Deluxe Triple or the Family Suite (up to five) beats booking several rooms, and the near-airport location suits early-morning arrivals or connections.
pros: A high-scoring budget chain, 9.0 across 223 reviews, from ฿550
Modern, fairly fresh, clean rooms
Near Ubon airport, with free parking
Has a Family Suite that sleeps up to five

entries.name: The Outside Inn
entries.addr: 11 Suriyat Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani
entries.storyHtml: The Outside Inn is a boutique garden guesthouse run by a Thai-American couple, scoring 9.0 across 28 reviews. It sits on Suriyat Road, near Ubon airport. The draw is a warm, homey garden-house feel, with spacious high-ceilinged rooms, Thai-Mexican food on-site, free breakfast and free parking. It's a fit for those who want a friendly guesthouse feel over a chain hotel, or international travellers who want English-speaking owners. Real reviews praise the garden setting, the owners' warmth, the food and the cleanliness.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a group or with kids, the connecting Family rooms are handy, and don't miss the on-site food with both Thai and Mexican dishes — the owners give good tips on what to see around Ubon.
pros: A garden guesthouse with a warm, homey feel, scoring 9.0
Thai-American owners, English-speaking, with good local tips
Has Thai-Mexican food and free breakfast

entries.name: Tohsang City Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Palochai Rd · central, near the airport
entries.addr: 251 Palochai Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani
entries.storyHtml: Tohsang City Hotel is the in-town branch of the Tohsang brand, known for its Mun riverside resort at Khong Chiam, a 4-star city hotel scoring 8.6 across 112 reviews. It sits on Palochai Road in a quiet residential area, a small hotel of around 33 rooms in a contemporary-vintage style. What guests talk about most is the breakfast and the cleanliness, and there's an on-site restaurant and free parking. It's a fit for those who want a quiet, clean stay with a good breakfast, or who are connecting onward to Khong Chiam and Pha Taem. Real reviews praise the breakfast, the quiet and the friendly service, even if the decor feels classic and there's some aircraft noise at times.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If aircraft noise bothers you, ask for an inner room not facing the airport, and pick the Grand Deluxe with a balcony for a multi-night stay — more space for not much more. For dinner, head into Thung Si Mueang for more food choices.

Clean rooms, a quiet atmosphere, good for resting
Tohsang brand, with an on-site restaurant and free parking

entries.storyHtml: Eco Inn Lite is a great-value midrange hotel in the Thung Si Mueang area, well-reviewed with 122 reviews, scoring 8.3 from a starting price of just ฿550. It sits on Si Narong Road in the central Thung Si Mueang area, a walk to the park, temples and market. The draw is a 7-Eleven right next door, free bikes for exploring the old town, free parking and clean, modern rooms. It's a tidy choice for those who want a central location at a budget price. Real reviews praise the cleanliness, the location, the value and the free bikes.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Borrow the hotel's free bikes to explore Thung Si Mueang and the old town — easy and fun — and the 25 sqm Superior King has a desk, handy if you're working.

entries.name: 28 Rachabutr Hostel
entries.revCount: 297 reviews · the most-reviewed in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Rachabutr Rd · by the Mun River
tags: 🚶 Walk to the market and Thung Si Mueang
entries.addr: 28 Rachabutr Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani
entries.storyHtml: 28 Rachabutr Hostel is a hostel in a 60-year-old wooden house by the Mun River, and the most-reviewed in this list with 297 reviews, scoring 8.3 from a starting price of just ฿350. It sits on Rachabutr Road by the Mun River, across from the riverside morning market. The draw is the charm of an old wooden house with an old-town feel, walkable to the market and Thung Si Mueang, ranging from a dorm bed up to a private AC room, some with city or river views. It's a fit for backpackers, solo travellers, or anyone who loves a wooden riverside feel. Real reviews praise the atmosphere, the riverside location, the price and the friendly hosts — but note it's cash only.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Bring enough cash, as the hostel is cash only, and ask for a private AC room with a city or river view for the full Mun riverside feel. An early-morning walk across to the riverside market is easy from here.

A 60-year-old wooden house by the Mun River, with old-town charm

From just ฿350, with both dorms and private AC rooms

The draw is a swimming pool — rare at this price — plus a free airport shuttle, with 2024-renovated rooms looking fresher, ranging from a double up to family rooms. It's a choice for those who want a pool in the centre at a budget price. Real reviews praise the pool, the location and the value, even if parts of the hotel are showing their age.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Use the hotel's free airport shuttle to save on transport, and ask for a 2024-renovated room for a fresher feel. The Thung Si Mueang location is a walk to the park and market.

entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a multi-night stay or in hot weather, the AC room is worth the few hundred baht over the fan room, and the Thung Si Mueang location is a walk to the park and market. Check the room condition at check-in, as it's an older hotel.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Ubon Ratchathani hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in Ubon Ratchathani?
faq.a: Ubon Ratchathani is compact, with most things in town · Thung Si Mueang · city centre suits walking to the park, temples and market (Eco Inn Lite, Laithong, Tokyo, The Ratchathani) · Sunee City Mall suits shopping and walking straight into the mall (Sunee Grand) · The airport quarter suits fly-in and connecting travellers (Rapeepan Ville, B2 Ubon, The Outside Inn, Tohsang City) · The Mun riverside suits an old-town feel (28 Rachabutr) · A Grab gets you between all of them easily.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Ubon Ratchathani hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: hostels and budget stays from about ฿350 a night · 3-star in-town hotels around ฿550–800 · boutiques and 4-star hotels around ฿700–1,200 · a 5-star mall hotel from around ฿900 · During the Candle Festival (July) and long weekends, prices rise and rooms fill very fast.

faq.q: ❓ Do I need a vehicle in Ubon Ratchathani?
faq.a: Not within the city, since most key spots are close together and a Grab or songthaew gets you around easily · It's about 10 minutes from Ubon Ratchathani Airport (UBP) into town · But to head out of town — to Khong Chiam, Pha Taem, Sam Phan Bok, or across into Laos at Chong Mek — renting a car is far more convenient and flexible, as these are tens of kilometres from the city.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book an Ubon Ratchathani hotel?
faq.a: For ordinary weekdays, booking 1–2 weeks ahead is fine · But during the Candle Festival (July) at Thung Si Mueang — Ubon's big annual event — plus long weekends and Songkran, the city fills up and in-town rooms go fast while prices rise, so book several weeks to 1–2 months ahead.

faq.q: ❓ Should I stay near the airport or in the city centre?
faq.a: Staying near the airport suits early-morning arrivals, connecting onward, or heading out to Khong Chiam and Pha Taem (Rapeepan Ville, B2 Ubon, The Outside Inn, Tohsang City) · Staying in the centre / Thung Si Mueang suits exploring in town, walking the park and temples, or shopping at the mall (Sunee Grand, V Hotel, Eco Inn Lite) · Ubon's airport is very close to town (about 10 minutes) and a Grab gets you between the areas easily, so pick the area closest to what you came for.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Ubon Ratchathani hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion and period, so we recommend opening all 3 to compare before every booking — each review page in this article gives you the price-comparison links, which can save several hundred baht a night.
